name: bun-pty-rust
description: Fork of `bun-pty` - cross-platform pseudoterminal (PTY) implementation for Bun with native performance

scripts.build:ts: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --declaration --external bun:ffi && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.build:publish: bun run copy-libs-to-dist && bun run build:ts
scripts.test: cd rust-pty && cargo build --release && cd .. && bun test src/
scripts.test:integration: cd rust-pty && cargo build --release && cd .. && RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true bun test src/terminal.integration.test.ts
